scope.surface: File editor after a real content change, through pending, confirmed or failed save, navigation, and reopen

newScope: The existing file-editor-detail states certify preview content, editor geometry, source styling, file switching, and Back navigation. They do not certify a real content mutation or any persistence lifecycle.

Web authority edits through the Pierre contentEditable surface and a shared FileSaveCoordinator. Lynx enters a native textarea from the preview and uses the same coordinator abstraction plus the project write RPC.

A user can change file contents, observe pending state, leave the editor before the debounce expires, encounter a write failure, retry, return to Files, and reopen the file. These are distinct state and interaction contracts from a static preview.
The state is P1 because a false saved state, dropped final revision, or missing failure feedback can lose user work.
missingCoverage: Current Browser workbench file-detail flows open and return but never send text input to either editor.
Current Native packaged readiness verifies preview-to-textarea mode, typography, token tones, and Back, but not physical typing, write persistence, status feedback, or reopen identity.
FileSaveCoordinator unit tests prove debounce serialization in isolation. They do not prove Web or Lynx input wiring, host lifecycle ordering, server persistence, or visual status semantics.
Existing evidence explicitly labels Native physical keyboard editing, selection, and save confirmation pending-user-session.
intentionalPlatformDelta: Web uses a Pierre contentEditable editor while Lynx uses a native textarea kernel. The state compares changed contents, save lifecycle, feedback, navigation safety, and persistence rather than identical editor internals.
classification.evidenceBoundary: Registration is denominator-only. It is grounded in current source contracts, the existing static file-detail captures, the shared coordinator unit suite, and the absence of any integrated text-input/write/reopen evidence. No product-repair credit is assigned; all twelve new Lynx-for-Web and Native dimension cells remain conservative unknown.

lynx.editor: Native textarea entered by tapping the tokenized preview

sharedCoordinatorTests: debounces edits and persists only the latest contents
keeps pending until an edit made during an in-flight write is saved
leaves pending when the latest write fails
flushes the latest revision before debounce expiry
does not rewrite a confirmed revision on dispose

denominatorChange.reason: Editing and save lifecycle is user-reachable, data-loss-sensitive, and not represented by the existing static preview, theme, or responsive file-detail states.
